scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.writeFileSync('./public/version.json', JSON.stringify({version: Date.now(), builtAt: new Date().toISOString()})));" && vite build
scripts.deploy: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => fs.writeFileSync('./public/version.json', JSON.stringify({version: Date.now(), builtAt: new Date().toISOString()})));" && vite build && cd dist && git init && git checkout -B gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -m "deploy" && git push -f https://github.com/mrtavor/FTM.git gh-pages
